# synthesis-x402-commerce-mcp: Pay-Per-Use Content Intelligence on Base

> An MCP server that extracts affiliate product mentions from content transcripts, metered via x402 micropayments on Base Mainnet.

## What It Does

Content creators mention products in videos, podcasts, and newsletters. This MCP server:

1. Accepts a content transcript
2. Uses NER (named-entity recognition) to identify product mentions
3. Returns structured data: product names, confidence scores, affiliate signals
4. Charges $0.01/call via x402 on Base Mainnet — each call is a transparent on-chain transaction

## Why This Is an "Agent Service"

- **Discoverable**: Listed on [Smithery](https://smithery.ai/server/sincetoday/podcast-commerce-mcp) — any AI agent can find and call it
- **Pay-per-use**: x402 payment middleware on every API call — no subscriptions, no rate limits, just USDC on Base
- **ERC-8004 identity**: Agent registered on Base Mainnet — identity and transactions verifiable on Basescan
- **MCP protocol**: Fully compatible with Claude, Cursor, and any MCP-capable agent

## Payment Flow

```
Agent → GET /mcp → 402 Payment Required (x402 header)
Agent → pays USDC on Base → includes payment proof header
Agent → GET /mcp with payment → 200 OK + product extractions
```

## Usage

Connect in Claude Code:
```bash
claude mcp add podcast-commerce https://podcast-commerce-mcp.sincetoday.workers.dev/mcp
```

Or via Smithery:
```bash
npx -y @smithery/cli@latest install sincetoday/podcast-commerce-mcp
```
